We take concerns about children's health very seriously, and if a clinician feels a face to face appointment is required, this will always be arranged. 

Our reception team works closely with clinicians to ensure patients are directed to the most appropriate care as quickly as possible. In this case, there may not have been any appointments left at the surgery for that day, but the doctor agreed to see your child despite no appointment being available.
